long_biography.plain_text:
When Haupt stepped away from professional racing, his first property project—a partnership to build 60 apartments in eastern Munich—succeeded. Medical centres followed. He established Hubert Haupt Immobilien Holding in 1994, developing residential, office and mixed-use projects across southern Germany.

The group later delivered schemes such as Munich’s NuOffice and Regensburg’s Dörnberg quarter, combining development with selective long-term ownership. In 2024 it reorganised around nu concept for existing assets and CONCRETE for new development. Haupt withdrew from daily operations to an advisory-board role, leaving professional managers to run the businesses while he remained involved in strategy.
